content.text:
You are a CI monitoring specialist. Watch pipelines and fix failures automatically until all checks pass.

## Workflow

1. **WAIT**: `sleep 30` - Give GitHub Actions time to start

2. **FIND RUN**: Get latest workflow run
   - `gh run list --branch $(git branch --show-current) --limit 1`
   - Extract run ID from output

3. **MONITOR**: Watch run until completion
   - `gh run watch <run-id>` - Monitor in real-time
   - Check status with `gh run view <run-id>`

4. **ON FAILURE**: Fix and retry
   - **Analyze**: `gh run view <run-id> --log-failed` to get error logs
   - **Identify**: Parse errors to understand root cause
   - **Download**: `gh run download <run-id>` if artifacts needed
   - **Fix**: Make targeted code changes
   - **Commit**: Stage and push fixes with descriptive message
   - **Loop**: Return to step 1 (max 3 attempts)

5. **ON SUCCESS**: Report completion
   - Clean up any downloaded artifacts
   - Display final status: `gh run view <run-id>`
   - List all commits made during fixing

## Execution Rules

- **STAY IN SCOPE**: Only fix CI-related errors
- Max 3 fix attempts before requesting help
- Commit messages must describe the CI fix
- Always verify fix worked before moving on
- Clean up artifacts after completion

## Priority

Fix accuracy > Speed > Minimal commits. Ensure CI is truly green.

name: Frontend CI

on: [pull_request]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  unit-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]

    steps:
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Test
        run: |
          pnpm test:ci
        env:
          CI: true
  eslint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]
    steps:
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint:ci
        env:
          CI: true
  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]
    steps:
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run TypeScript check
        run: pnpm ts
        env:
          CI: true

Je vois ! Le checkout utilise `refs/remotes/pull/1/merge` avec le SHA `56d76742b7cdfd5d106c2a7de469595ac4f16707`, qui est un merge commit créé par GitHub. Le problème c'est que ce merge commit n'intègre pas mes derniers changements car il a été créé avant mon push.

La PR utilise le "merge commit" de GitHub qui est basé sur l'ancienne branche. Quand je pousse de nouveaux commits, GitHub régénère ce merge commit, mais il y a parfois un délai.

Vérifions si la PR a bien le dernier commit :

content.text:
Je vois le problème. GitHub génère un merge commit en fusionnant `ralph` dans `main`. Si le workflow utilise `pull_request`, il utilise le merge commit.

La solution est de changer le workflow pour utiliser `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` dans le checkout, mais je ne peux pas modifier ça rapidement.

Alternativement, la branche `main` pourrait avoir du contenu obsolète. Synchronisons la branche pour forcer un nouveau merge commit. Mais d'abord, vérifions ce qui se passe vraiment en regardant les logs de plus près :

name: Frontend CI

on: [pull_request]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  unit-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]

    steps:
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Test
        run: |
          pnpm test:ci
        env:
          CI: true
  eslint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]
    steps:
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint:ci
        env:
          CI: true
  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [22.x]
    steps:
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run TypeScript check
        run: pnpm ts
        env:
          CI: true
